To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we prove the convergence of gradient flow for implicit neural networks with ReLU activation.
the gradient flow of over-parameterized implicit ReLU activated neural networks converges to a local minimum of the loss at a linear rate, and that this convergence is global.
we prove that the gradient flow of ReLU activated implicit neural networks converges to a local minimum at a linear speed for the square loss.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the global convergence of implicit neural networks, and provides an affirmative theoretical answer to the empirical observations.
the convergence of (over-parameterized) implicit neural networks and establishes the first convergence theory for the training of ReLU activated implicit neural networks via gradient descent.
the global convergence of (S-)GD on infinite-layer neural networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a randomly initialized (S)GD converges to a minimum of the square loss function for a ReLU activated implicit neural network with a linear rate if the network is over-parameterization.
a gradient descent on a ReLU activated implicit neural network with over-parameterization can always achieve global convergence.
the gradient flow of over-parameterized ReLU activated implicit neural networks converges globally at a linear rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the gradient flow of a randomly initialized ReLU-activated implicit neural network with an over-parameterization rate of $\mathcal{O}(\frac{m}{\sqrt{n}})$ converges linearly to a global minimum for the square loss.
the gradient descent on implicit neural networks with ReLU activations converges globally at a linear rate under the assumption of over-parameterization.
the gradient descent can solve a nonlinear implicit system with a linear rate, if the implicit system is over-parameterized.
The main takeaway from our work is that
over-parameterization is a crucial ingredient in the convergence analysis of implicit neural networks.
over-parameterization is essential for implicit neural networks to guarantee the global convergence.
, the over-parametrization can be viewed as a regularization mechanism for implicit neural networks.
